title: agreement (fovariant-3)

freshResult.formula: Exists q0: cube. Exists q1: cube. Forall q2: sphere. behind(q2,q1) AND front(q2,q0)

referenceResult.formula: Exists q0: cube. Exists q1: cube. Forall q2: sphere. right(q2,q1) AND left(q2,q0)

intendedConcept: For every cylinder there is a sphere to the left of it and to the right of it.
